title: bomify plugin SupportedSignatureTypesResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success for its "signature supported-types" subcommand, per plugins/contracts/signing/v1/CONTRACT.md. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

artifactTypes.description: The referrer artifact types this plugin's "signature verify" understands. bomify never passes "signature verify" an envelope from a referrer of any other type.
